exact_statement: For every finite Boolean sign whose positive event is the union of two conjunction terms, and every independent interior product input law, corrected entropy in bits obeys Hplus<=K*(I-Var), K=4+12/ln(2); the same K gives ordinary H<=K*I at uniform inputs and applies after deterministic contraction and output negation. If the two terms have at most one opposing shared literal, exact disjoint factorization gives the sharper Cstar=2+4/ln(2). After removing constants and irrelevant groups, the only essential nonbinary prime root shapes in this two-term class are ternary mux and T_{r,g}, r>=2, g in {0,1,2}, where T is positive at the all-one conflicting-data corner with its first guard and the all-zero corner with its second guard, with absent guards fixed true. Every T_{r,g} is prime and has the uniform all-bias bound K. The exact labeled census from pairs of consistent conjunctions has 10,52,168 essential primes at n=2,3,4, and 10,80,336 after output negation. In particular the four-input prime mask33152 is bounded over its entire bias continuum, without a sharp-optimum assertion. The prime mask56067, positive on {Y1=1,Y2=1,Z=1} or {Y1=0,Y3=1,Z=1} or {Y2=0,Y3=0}, has exact constituent deficit loss delta(F)-sum delta(fi)=-2*v1*p2*p3*p4*(1-p4), equal to -1/8 at uniform bias; no all-bias entropy theorem for this three-term prime or full FEI is asserted.
hypotheses: Finite Boolean sign functions, normalized product Fourier basis and independent Bernoulli coordinates
v_i=4p_i(1-p_i), corrected Hplus=sum_{S nonempty}P(S)log2(v_S/P(S)); I spectral expected degree, Var=sum_{S nonempty}P(S)
Terms are conjunctions of literals; internally contradictory terms are removed, repeated literals deduplicated, empty groups treated as constants
Prime classification removes irrelevant physical coordinates and uses genuine one-bit block substitution with disjoint supports
The overlap entropy proof uses at least two opposing shared literals; zero/one-conflict cases use the explicitly stated disjoint decomposition
All quotient inequalities use interior laws; degenerate inputs contracted before normalization; zero entropy terms treated continuously
K is a proved nonsharp upper bound; no many-term/arbitrary-prime/all-dimensional claim is made

exact_statement: For every Boolean sign gate under any interior independent Bernoulli law, the exact unused singleton reserve is 4D-2R-E_single=sum_i v_i[2(d_i-t_i)+2t_i(1-t_i)-t_i^2 ln(1/t_i^2)], where D=I-Var, R=sum_{|S|>=3}(|S|-2)P(S), d_i=E D_i^2, t_i=|E D_i|, and D_i is the half-difference derivative. Each displayed local contribution is nonnegative, and d_i-t_i=2min(P(D_i=1),P(D_i=-1)). For the four-input prime positive exactly at assignments 7,8,15 (mask33152), with first three input probabilities 1/2 and fourth probability z in [0,1], D=(5+14z-7z^2)/16 and E=4h((1-z)/4)+3h((1+z)/4)+(z(1-z)/2)ln64, h(t)=t^2ln(1/t^2). Its full natural corrected entropy margin satisfies (4+ln4)D-E >= (10-9ln2)/8 >47/100, with equality in the first inequality at z=0. At z=0, E=(7/4)ln2+[(5/2)ln2+1/8]z+O(z^2) and Hplus/D tends to 28/5. At s=1-z=0, E=(3/2)ln2+[3/4+(3/2)ln2]s+(1/2)s^2ln(1/s)+O(s^2), and Hplus/D tends to 2. The general four-bias prime inequality and all-dimensional FEI remain open.
